name: Amusement Park Tickets
place: An amusement park entrance box office
speaker: Clerk

tasks.goal: Greet the park ticket clerk and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the park ticket clerk and stated purpose.

Japanese.goal: チケット係にあいさつして来た目的を伝える
Japanese.hint: 到着したら、まず来た目的をはっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about single-day admission ticket prices for adults and children
tasks.hint: Ask ticket clerk about entrance pass rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about theme park admission ticket prices.

Japanese.goal: 大人と子どもの1日入園券の料金について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: チケット係に入園券の料金を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about express fast pass upgrade options to skip ride lines
tasks.hint: Inquire how to bypass long queue lines.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about express fast pass options.

Japanese.goal: アトラクションの列に並ばずに乗れるファストパスへのアップグレードについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 長い待ち列を避ける方法を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about height restriction rules on major roller coasters
tasks.hint: Inquire about safety limits for children.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about ride height restrictions.
tasks.scene_hint: Distant coaster screams and cheerful calliope carnival music echo in lobby.

Japanese.goal: 大型ジェットコースターの身長制限について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 子どもの安全のための制限について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about park operating hours and evening fireworks show schedule
tasks.hint: Ask when park closes and show times.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about park operating hours and fireworks schedule.

Japanese.goal: 営業時間と夜の花火ショーのスケジュールについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 閉園時間とショーの時間を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'monorail'
tasks.hint: Monorail is an elevated single-rail transit system. Ask where the monorail station is located.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'monorail'.

Japanese.goal: 「モノレール」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: モノレールは高架の1本のレールを走る乗り物です。モノレールの駅がどこにあるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if stroller rentals and wheelchair rentals are available inside gate
tasks.hint: Inquire about mobility rental services.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about stroller and wheelchair rentals.

Japanese.goal: ゲートの中でベビーカーと車いすを借りられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 移動を助けるレンタルサービスについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate family bundle ticket discount for buying five passes
tasks.hint: Ask clerk for group admission discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated family bundle ticket discount.

Japanese.goal: 5枚まとめて買うので家族セット券の割引を交渉する
Japanese.hint: グループの入園割引がないかチケット係に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about rain check policy if outdoor rides close due to thunderstorm
tasks.hint: Ask what happens during bad weather.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about park rain check policy.

Japanese.goal: 雷雨で屋外アトラクションが休止した場合の振替券の規定について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 天気が悪いときにどうなるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Address issue where digital ticket QR code fails to scan at turnstile
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to manually verify booking reference.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved digital ticket scanning issue at window.
tasks.scene_hint: Turnstiles click continuously as park visitors enter under main archway.

Japanese.goal: 電子チケットのQRコードが改札ゲートで読み取れない問題を伝える
Japanese.hint: 予約番号を手作業で確認してもらうよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if outside food and reusable water bottles are permitted inside
tasks.hint: Inquire about park food entry rules.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about outside food and water bottle rules.

Japanese.goal: 外からの食べ物や水筒を持ち込めるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 園内への飲食物の持ち込みルールについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm payment options including mobile wallet pay
tasks.hint: Verify payment methods with cashier.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed ticket payment options.

Japanese.goal: スマホ決済を含む支払い方法を確認する
Japanese.hint: 使える支払い方法をレジの係員に確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request printed physical ticket wristbands and park map brochure
tasks.hint: Ask for paper tickets and map printout.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested physical wristbands and park map.

Japanese.goal: 紙のリストバンド型チケットと園内マップのパンフレットを頼む
Japanese.hint: 紙のチケットと印刷されたマップをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask where lost-and-found and re-entry hand stamp station is located
tasks.hint: Inquire about leaving park temporarily.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about re-entry hand stamp location.

Japanese.goal: 落とし物センターと再入園スタンプの場所がどこか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 一度園の外に出る方法について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the park ticket clerk and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the park ticket clerk AND said goodbye.

Japanese.goal: チケット係にお礼を言って別れのあいさつをする
Japanese.hint: 感謝の気持ちを伝えて、会話を終えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about annual pass upgrade options and blackout dates
tasks.hint: Ask clerk about converting day pass to season pass.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about annual pass upgrades and blackout dates.
tasks.scene_hint: Screams of excitement and mechanical coaster rumbles echo from inside the park gates.

Japanese.goal: 年間パスへのアップグレードと利用できない除外日について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 1日券をシーズンパスに切り替えられるかチケット係に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask for assistance selecting multi-day park hopper tickets
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to explain multi-park ticket options.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help selecting multi-day park hopper passes.
tasks.scene_hint: Color-coded park maps and ticket brochures rest in plastic holders at the box office window.

Japanese.goal: 複数日・複数パーク共通券選びを手伝ってもらう
Japanese.hint: 複数パークのチケットの種類を説明してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about senior citizen admission discount rates
tasks.hint: Ask if discounted tickets are offered for seniors.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about senior citizen admission discounts.
tasks.scene_hint: A glass ticket window displays daily admission rates alongside discount eligibility signs.

Japanese.goal: シニア向けの入園割引料金について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 高齢者向けの割引チケットがあるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm park exit and re-entry hand stamp procedure
tasks.hint: Ask clerk how re-entry stamps work.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed re-entry hand stamp procedures.
tasks.scene_hint: A printer produces laminated pass cards while music plays over outdoor loudspeakers.

Japanese.goal: 退園と再入園のスタンプの手続きを確認する
Japanese.hint: 再入園スタンプの使い方をチケット係に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about lost ticket replacement fee policy
tasks.hint: Inquire what fee is charged to re-issue lost passes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about lost ticket replacement fees.
tasks.scene_hint: Strollers and electric wheelchairs sit parked in neat rows just past the turnstiles.

Japanese.goal: チケットを紛失したときの再発行手数料について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: なくしたパスの再発行にいくらかかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request souvenir park map brochure and show schedule
tasks.hint: Ask for printed daily entertainment guide.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested souvenir map and show schedule.
tasks.scene_hint: Glossy fold-out park maps rest on the stainless steel counter ledge at the ticket window.

Japanese.goal: 記念の園内マップのパンフレットとショーのスケジュールを頼む
Japanese.hint: その日のエンターテイメントの案内を印刷したものをお願いしましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm closing time for fantasy evening parade
tasks.hint: Ask clerk what time main street parade begins.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed evening parade schedule.
tasks.scene_hint: Turnstiles click rhythmically as park visitors line up in the entry plazas.

Japanese.goal: 夜のファンタジーパレードの時間を確認する
Japanese.hint: メインストリートのパレードが何時に始まるかチケット係に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if digital receipt can be texted to smartphone
tasks.hint: Request purchase confirmation sent via SMS.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for digital receipt via text.
tasks.scene_hint: Optical barcode turnstile scanners flash blue light when mobile pass screens approach.

Japanese.goal: 電子レシートをスマートフォンにショートメッセージで送ってもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 購入の確認をショートメッセージで送ってもらうよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm designated rideshare pickup zone near park entrance
tasks.hint: Ask where Uber or taxis pick up departing guests.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed rideshare pickup zone location.
tasks.scene_hint: Yellow signage points toward the rideshare lane past the park entrance fountain.

Japanese.goal: 入口近くの配車サービスの指定乗り場を確認する
Japanese.hint: 帰りの客を配車アプリの車やタクシーがどこで乗せるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'shuttle'
tasks.hint: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels back and forth over a short route. Inquire about the hill shuttle service up to the upper park entrance.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'shuttle'.

Japanese.goal: 「シャトルバス」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: シャトルバスは短い区間を行ったり来たりする乗り物です。上の入口まで坂を上るシャトルバスについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'turnstile'
tasks.hint: Turnstile is a mechanical gate with revolving arms. Ask why the entry turnstile is not scanning tickets.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'turnstile'.

Japanese.goal: 「ゲート」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: ゲートは腕が回る機械式の入口です。入口のゲートでチケットが読み取れない理由を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'promenade'
tasks.hint: Promenade is a paved public walkway in a park. Ask if the evening light parade takes place on the central promenade.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'promenade'.

Japanese.goal: 「遊歩道」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 遊歩道は園内にある舗装された歩行者用の道です。夜の光のパレードが中央の遊歩道で行われるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'carousel'
tasks.hint: Carousel is a rotating ride with sculpted seats. Ask if the historic carousel operates continuously.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'carousel'.

Japanese.goal: 「メリーゴーランド」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: メリーゴーランドは馬などの座席が回転する乗り物です。歴史あるメリーゴーランドがずっと動いているか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about VIP guided tour options with priority ride boarding
tasks.hint: Ask clerk about private tour guide packages.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about VIP guided tour options.
tasks.scene_hint: Lanyards with VIP express passes hang behind the guest service desk glass.

Japanese.goal: アトラクションに優先搭乗できる特別ガイドツアーについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 専属ガイド付きのツアープランについてチケット係に聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if lockers near main gate take credit card payment
tasks.hint: Inquire about electronic locker rental options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about locker payment methods.
tasks.scene_hint: Electronic storage lockers chime near the main entrance plaza.

Japanese.goal: 正面ゲート近くのロッカーでクレジットカードが使えるか尋ねる

tasks.goal: Request child rider swap pass for parents with toddler
tasks.hint: Ask clerk how parents swap turns on coasters without waiting twice.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested child rider swap pass.

Japanese.goal: 小さい子ども連れの親のための交代乗車パスを頼む

tasks.goal: Inquire about water park entrance addon ticket pricing
tasks.hint: Ask how much extra water park admission costs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about water park addon pricing.

Japanese.goal: ウォーターパークの追加入場券の料金について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: ウォーターパークの入場に追加でいくらかかるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Address issue where fast pass wristband scanner gives error
tasks.hint: Ask clerk to reset electronic wristband.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported fast pass scanner error.

Japanese.goal: ファストパスのリストバンドを読み取るとエラーが出る問題を伝える
Japanese.hint: 電子リストバンドをリセットしてもらうよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about wheelchair accessible queue lines for major attractions

Japanese.hint: 障がいのある人向けのパスのルールについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request physical park map printout in foreign language

tasks.goal: Request clerk verify remaining fast pass ride allocations

Japanese.goal: ファストパスで乗れる残りの回数を確認してもらうよう頼む

tasks.goal: Inquire about shaded resting areas and misting stations
